name_vi: Túi xách trụ đứng nắp lật
description_en: A tall cylindrical woven handbag with flat circular base, hinged circular lid and arch handle. Canonical front: a narrow leather closure bridging the lid rim. Side view: the round wall and side handle pivot. Rear view: the lid hinge and uninterrupted cylinder wall. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: A tall cylindrical woven handbag with flat circular base, hinged circular lid and arch handle. Canonical front: a narrow leather closure bridging the lid rim. Side view: the round wall and side handle pivot. Rear view: the lid hinge and uninterrupted cylinder wall. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Modern: clean contemporary geometry. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE ELEVATION: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, level with product center. Show its right profile; front-facing panel must be edge-on. Do not merely flip or mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
